description: The MiSTer port of opl2_fpga (https://github.com/gtaylormb/opl2_fpga), the YM3812 cut of opl3_fpga. Only the synthesis core under channels is vendored; the host interface, clock divider, timers and LEDs are replaced by cores/fes-pc386/rtl/pc386_opl2.sv.
reference: Nuked-OPL3 765ec962e473aeb767e4cba74ffdc8f588ffbfe8 in OPL2 mode, default build (sample-exact; scripts/sim_fes_pc386.py --suite opl2)
local_changes: calc_envelope_shift.sv: EG_INC_STEP is a plain 16-bit localparam indexed by {rate_lo, eg_timer_lo}, the same bits a [3:0][3:0] typed localparam indexed [rate_lo][eg_timer_lo] reads; the locked Yosys rejects the typed 2-D localparam.
calc_envelope_shift.sv: EG_INC_STEP packed in the order its [rate_lo][eg_timer_lo] index reads; upstream had rows and bits reversed, which gave rates 12-14 the wrong step.
calc_phase_inc.sv: Vibrato offset added to the f-number before the block shift and multiplier, as Nuked-OPL3 does, instead of to the phase increment.
calc_rhythm_phase.sv: $bits(operator_t) is the constant 3 (OPERATOR_T_BITS), since the locked Yosys cannot take $bits of a type in an expression.
calc_rhythm_phase.sv: Noise LFSR as Nuked-OPL3's 23-bit Fibonacci register stepping once per operator slot (36 per sample); top-cymbal phase latched only in rhythm mode.
channels.sv: Channels 6-8 mix their second operator from the previous sample (Nuked-OPL3 OPL_QUIRK_CHANNELSAMPLEDELAY); channel sums are no longer doubled, so the output has Nuked-OPL3's scale.

channels.sv: state and self get their power-on values from initial statements instead of initializers on their anonymous enum and packed struct declarations, which the locked Yosys rejects. Same registers and values.
control_operators.sv: NTS is latched per channel when its A0h-A8h or B0h-B8h register is written, which is when Nuked-OPL3 derives the key scale value.

control_operators.sv: the operator alignment assertion is simulation-only (`ifndef SYNTHESIS`), as Yosys has no concurrent assertions; $bits(fnum[9:8]) is the constant 2, since the locked Yosys cannot take $bits of a part select.
envelope_generator.sv: The AM bit is pipelined to stage 2 with the operator; upstream read the register memory there, which by then shows the next operator.
envelope_generator.sv: the state memory's width is the constant 4 instead of $bits(state_t), which the locked Yosys cannot take in an expression.

mem_single_bank_reset.sv: state and self get their power-on values from initial statements instead of initializers on their anonymous enum and packed struct declarations, which the locked Yosys rejects. Same registers and values.
operator.sv: In rhythm mode a drum operator is keyed by its drum bit OR its channel key-on, as Nuked-OPL3 ORs the two key sources.
opl2_pkg.sv: INSTANTIATE_SAMPLE_DAC_CDC = 0: the sample stays in the machine clock domain; the mixer resamples it.
phase_generator.sv: $bits(operator_t) is the constant 3 (OPERATOR_T_BITS), since the locked Yosys cannot take $bits of a type in an expression.
phase_generator.sv: Key-on resets the phase accumulator to this sample's increment, not zero, as Nuked-OPL3 resets then adds.

pipeline_sr.sv: The power-on value is an initial replication instead of a '{default: POR_VALUE} pattern on the output declaration, which the locked Yosys rejects on a packed array (DeanoC/yosys issue linked in the pc386 M4 record). Same registers and values.
tremolo.sv: Tremolo rewritten to Nuked-OPL3's: position 0-209 stepping every 64 samples, depth shift 2 or 4, value for the next sample computed after the last operator.
vibrato.sv: Vibrato rewritten to Nuked-OPL3's: eight positions stepping every 1024 samples, giving a signed f-number offset.
